item.title: The Story the Data Won't Tell You
item.description:
Disclaimer: I am not an expert in COVID19, or medicine, or pathology. I am expressing personal opinions which do not reflect the views of any firm I am associated with. Please do not take anything I say as medical, financial, or personal advice.

COVID19 is upon us and we are seeing a near exponential growth in the number of cases right now. Most of us are experiencing this pandemic through the data. But there’s an issue with this data. It doesn’t tell the whole story.
